name: repo-fleet
description: DEPRECATED as a catalogue — use agent-toolworks/plugins. Kept working for existing installs. An opinionated environment for working across many repositories: a fleet of repos, per-ticket worktree workspaces, and search that understands both levels

plugins.name: fleet-workspace
plugins.description: Work on a ticket that spans several repositories: clone a fleet of repos once, then create a per-ticket workspace of git worktrees holding only the repos that ticket changes.

plugins.name: code-search
plugins.description: Search across many repositories at once — who calls an endpoint, where a symbol is defined, what implements an interface, which repo publishes a package, and when a cross-repo seam last changed. Routes each question to whichever of five engines can answer it, and labels every answer with the kind of evidence behind it.
